title: Strategic Index Reconstitution: Differential Games, Closed-Loop Equilibria and Mean-Field Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.15901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study strategic trading around index reconstitution in a continuous-time, multiasset game with transient cross-asset price impact and heterogeneous beliefs about future index membership. Opportunistic traders position before a public announcement, adjust to the revealed composition, and trade around an indexer following a prescribed execution schedule. Under a no-price-manipulation condition, we construct a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium on every finite horizon. The affine feedback policies are computed from a non-standard matrix Riccati equation and linear ordinary differential equations whose number and dimensions do not grow with the number of traders. Aggregate inventories and price impact depend on beliefs only through the population-average belief, while differences in beliefs affect individual inventory positions. translated_title: 策略性指数重构：微分博弈、闭环均衡与平均场动力学
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在具有瞬态跨资产价格冲击和对未来指数成分持有异质性信念的连续时间多资产博弈中，围绕指数重构的策略性交易。机会主义交易者在公开公告发布之前建仓，根据公布的成分构成进行调整，并围绕遵循预定执行计划的指数管理者进行交易。在无价格操纵条件下，我们在每个有限时间范围内构建了子博弈完美纳什均衡。仿射反馈策略由一个非标准矩阵Riccati方程和线性常微分方程计算得出，其数量和维度不会随交易者数量的增加而增长。总库存和价格冲击仅通过人口平均信念依赖于信念，而信念之间的差异会影响个体库存头寸。在平均场缩放条件下，我们构建了平均场均衡，并获得了定量收敛与近似结果。
tldr: 该论文在具有瞬态跨资产价格冲击和异质性信念的连续时间多资产博弈中，构建了围绕指数重构的策略性交易的子博弈完美纳什均衡与平均场均衡，其仿射反馈策略的计算复杂度不随交易者数量增长，且总库存与价格冲击仅依赖于平均信念。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs subgame-perfect Nash equilibria and mean-field equilibria for strategic trading around index reconstitution in a continuous-time multi-asset game with transient cross-asset price impact and heterogeneous beliefs, where affine feedback policies are computed via equations whose dimensions do not grow with the number of traders.
